recommendations.title: Make person selection clear and dependable
recommendations.current: Staff and Freelancer checkboxes have empty accessible names and24 x24px click targets. Their custom checked mark and focus handling bypass the approved DS control.
recommendations.proposal: Use the existing DS Checkbox, associate it with the visible person name and keep the approved44px target and focus treatment. Make the name/selection area clickable; keep capacity metadata and the project-rate input independently operable.
recommendations.rationale: A small shared-control repair improves pointer selection, keyboard orientation and person identification without changing who can be selected.
recommendations.tradeoff: Do not make the entire Freelancer row a label: it contains a separate rate input. Keep Staff single-selection with deselection and Freelancer multi-selection; no radio conversion.

recommendations.title: Name the project-rate column
recommendations.current: The row shows a person’s hourly reference under their name and a dollar input on the right. “Project rate for Hugo Bennett” exists for assistive technology, but the visible column has no Project rate heading.
recommendations.proposal: Add a small visible “Project rate” heading above the Freelancer amount column. Keep person identity and hourly reference on the left, existing total project-rate input on the right, and align the rows consistently.
recommendations.classification: Heuristic UI-clarity judgement; not a demonstrated user failure
recommendations.finding: New scoped refinement, no defect-total inflation
recommendations.rationale: This distinguishes the hourly reference from the project amount without adding fields or explanatory clutter.
recommendations.tradeoff: Use one column heading rather than repeat the label on every row. Do not change rates, rounding, calculations, defaults or save boundaries; preserve person-specific accessible input names.

recommendations.title: Explain an empty Staff shortlist
recommendations.current: Shooter > Staff has no suggested people and shows only Show all10. It does not explain that the shortlist, rather than the Studio team, is empty.
recommendations.proposal: Add one quiet line: “No suggested Staff for Shooter.” Keep the existing Show all10 action and current filtering. Use the role’s existing label for other roles.
recommendations.rationale: Clarifies the scope of the empty result with a single line and keeps the next action obvious.
recommendations.tradeoff: No illustration, new invitation action or automatic expansion to all Staff. Those would add noise or change behaviour.
